compute_mae: compute the mean absolute error between predicted and target tensor values for MLIP evaluation
compute_mse: compute the mean squared error between predicted and target tensor values for MLIP evaluation
compute_cosine_similarity: compute cosine similarity between predicted and target tensor values for directional property comparison
compute_per_atom_metrics: compute per-atom MAE or MSE metrics normalized by atom count for energy and force evaluation
evaluate_energy_forces_threshold: evaluate the fraction of systems where energy and force errors fall within specified thresholds
